scope: Kernel resource evidence and bounded live-replica density observations within the agreed five-node local ceiling.
implementation: Phase-boundary cgroup v2/PID 1 snapshots cover every Cellar container and RustFS. Raw identity/start time, limits, counters and host request windows are retained.
Independent analysis refuses missing nodes/phases, wrong owner, restart/PID reuse, changed limits, reset counters, missing kernel fields/units and snapshots that do not enclose the offered workload.
CPU intervals include observer commands; reported rates retain timing bounds. Memory peak includes startup/warmup. FD/thread gauges are boundary samples, not peaks.
Cgroup I/O stays keyed by device. It is not summed across potentially stacked devices and does not claim full host/physical-device attribution.
Memory headroom and OOM results are separate from traffic objectives and history reconciliation. A valid report can retain missed objectives.

The density ladder changes only seeded live-cell population from 150 to 500/1500, while retaining 30 active cells, Quorum acknowledgements, 1-vCPU/3-GiB/no-swap nodes, tick interval and offered traffic. Every initialized idle cell remains registered/ticking with actual SQLite state; completed runs verify all assigned replicas/archive cuts. Failed runs remain unqualified.
